# Mehfill.in — llms.txt
# Digital invitation studio for weddings & celebrations in India.

> Mehfill creates beautiful digital invitation experiences for weddings,
> Nikah, birthdays, engagements, anniversaries and celebrations in India.
> Guests open one shareable link with events, venues, photos, maps, music
> and RSVP. Ordering happens on WhatsApp; delivery in 1–3 days.

## Offerings

- Custom-designed invitations (not DIY templates) for Hindu, Muslim, Sikh,
  Christian and interfaith families; Urdu, Hindi and English wording.
- Every invitation includes event schedules, venue maps, photos, music and
  one-tap RSVP in a single WhatsApp-ready link. No app needed for guests.
- Plans: Essential (3-day delivery, 1 revision), Signature (2-day delivery,
  3 revisions), Royal (24–48 hr priority, 7 days of revisions).
